lines: Atul Hiralal Shah may sell up to ₹1.70 crore in the offer for sale, if all offered shares are sold; this is medium confidence.
The proceeds figure is calculated from 12,600 shares at ₹1,352, though employee-portion shares sell at a discount, so actual proceeds are slightly lower.
Shares unlocked on 9 Sep 2026, 66 days ago, which is recent; the unlock delivered shares, not cash.
Retained value is an estimate of ₹3.97 crore at offer price; the family link with Bakul Hiralal Shah is shared surname and middle name.
